ideas.title: Why the Octopus Changes Color in a Split Second #Shorts
ideas.concept: Explain how octopus skin cells (chromatophores) let it instantly camouflage for hunting and hiding.
ideas.hook: Watch this octopus vanish… it’s not magic—it’s living pixels.
ideas.keyVisual: Close-up stock footage of an octopus on reef rock rapidly shifting from mottled brown to bright/striped patterns while moving.

ideas.title: Why the Hummingbird Can Hover Like a Helicopter #Shorts
ideas.concept: Break down the unique wingbeat motion that allows hovering and flying backward.
ideas.hook: This bird can stop midair and even fly backwards—here’s the trick.
ideas.keyVisual: High-speed style clip of a hummingbird hovering at a flower, then reversing slightly and repositioning.

ideas.title: Why the Crocodile Can Hold Its Breath for Over an Hour #Shorts
ideas.concept: Teach the simple physiology (slow metabolism + efficient oxygen use) behind long underwater ambushes.
ideas.hook: A crocodile can wait underwater longer than you can watch this video.
ideas.keyVisual: Crocodile barely submerged at water surface with only eyes/nose visible, then slow underwater glide toward prey area.

ideas.title: 5 Animals With Senses You Wish You Had
ideas.concept: Weekly long-form compilation stitching together the best Shorts from the past week with bridging narration. Features dolphin (echolocation sleep), turtle (butt breathing), bear (20-mile smell), lion (5-mile roar), and tiger (6x night vision).
ideas.hook: These 5 animals have superpowers you can only dream of — and they use them every single day.
ideas.keyVisual: Split-screen composite of 5 animal faces (dolphin, turtle, bear, lion, tiger) with bold 'SUPERPOWERS' text overlay

longFormPlan.concept: Weekly 6-8 minute compilation video stitching together the week's best-performing Shorts with connecting narration, chapter markers, and a unified theme (e.g. '5 Animals With Superpowers You Didn't Know Existed').
longFormPlan.rationale: Long-form videos earn watch hours toward the 4,000-hour YPP threshold (currently at 127.8/4000 = 3.2%), get recommended to broader audiences beyond Shorts feed, and rank in YouTube search. Each weekly compilation reuses existing footage + narration with new bridging content — high ROI, low production cost.
longFormPlan.cadence: Weekly — Sunday production, published Sunday evening

format.structure: Cold open hook (10s) → 5-7 Shorts segments stitched with 5-10s bridging narration between each → outro with channel CTA (15s)
format.segments: Select top 5-7 Shorts from the past 7 days by views + retention. Prioritize WINNER-labeled videos.
format.bridging: New TTS narration connecting segments thematically (e.g. 'Speaking of super senses...')
format.chapters: YouTube chapter timestamps in description for each animal segment
format.thumbnail: Composite of top 3 animal thumbnails with bold text overlay

productionFlow: 1. Read pulse-snapshot.json + producer-analytics.json to select top 5-7 Shorts from the past 7 days
2. Download each Short's final.mp4 from produced-videos records (or re-render from cached clips)
3. Write bridging narration script (50-80 words of connective tissue between segments)
4. Generate TTS for bridges + intro + outro
5. Assemble with ffmpeg: concat segments with bridges, add chapter markers
6. Upload as a standard video (not Shorts) with chapter timestamps in description
prerequisites: Durable storage for final.mp4 files (currently in /tmp which clears between runs — need to cache to workspace)
New Sunday cron task for long-form production
Updated assemble script to support concatenation mode with bridges

yppImpact.watchHoursPerWeek: ~1.5-2 hours per compilation (6-8 min × 15-25 views in first week)
yppImpact.note: Long-form watch hours compound — videos keep getting views over months. Real impact likely 2-3x the first-week numbers.
